raw_definitions: Definisi : 2. (fig.) bergolak: the meeting was a ~ one, and the chairman was constantly calling it to order, mesyuarat itu begitu bergolak sehingga pengerusi sentiasa meminta supaya bertenang. (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
Definisi : adj 1. (bercuaca) buruk; (of sea) bergelora: the ~ weather along the coast, cuaca buruk di sepanjang kawasan pantai itu; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
